result:
Fixed. The classifier's plain-text score `100` no longer gets dropped, so the router now routes on it instead of falling back to the requested model. I haven't run the tests.

The bug was in `parse_classifier_score` in `anthrouter/model_router.py`. Its range check was `0 <= value < 100`, which rejected exactly 100. I changed it to `0 <= value <= 100`, matching the function's docstring ("int in [0, 100]") and the existing check in the JSON parser at line 1294.
